title: Heavenly Dao's Eye
next_chapter_hook: Cang Yutian's consciousness pressed down like a tangible force, and Chen Ji felt the entire forbidden land trembling beneath its overwhelming pressure—and he must make a life-or-death choice under this gaze that could annihilate everything.

text.content: The chaotic power deep within the forbidden land churned like tides. Chen Ji stabilized his stance, his gaze piercing through layers of mist to lock onto the source of that ancient voice. There, a massive eye hovered—the pupil contained a vast starry river, while three thousand great dao patterns flowed across its iris, the vicissitudes of countless eons contained within. Yet now, that eye was covered in cracks, golden light continuously leaking from the fissures.

dialogue.content: "Finally... someone has arrived." The voice was no longer an elderly sigh, but carried a weariness born from surviving countless tribulations. "Chen Ji, keeper of the Tianji Record. I have waited... for you... for a very long time."

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, his palm growing faintly warm—the Tianji Record fragment was vibrating intensely, as if responding to some ancient summoning. He lowered his gaze to the back of his hand, where the fragment's mark was emitting a faint glow synchronized with his heartbeat.

dialogue.content: "Did you think it was a cultivation technique, a legacy?" The Heavenly Dao's Eye's pupil slightly contracted, emitting a low moan that sounded like weeping and laughing. "It is mine... the part of me that was taken away."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart jolted. The Tianji Record was part of the Heavenly Dao's Eye? This information was overwhelming. His first instinct was to activate the Tianji Record's foresight ability, yet at this moment, he discovered in horror—the massive eye was gazing at him, as if it could see through everything about him.

dialogue.content: "No need to test." The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice was terrifyingly calm. "The future you wish to see—everything within three hours—I can tell you. But in exchange, you need to help me with one thing."

text.content: "What?" Chen Ji's voice was steady as usual, but his clenched fists revealed the turmoil within. Probably few in this world could remain composed before the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

dialogue.content: "Retrieve my body." Black mist gushed from the Heavenly Dao's Eye's cracks. "A million kalpas ago, I was not this fragmented soul. I was the guardian of this universe, the executor of all heavenly laws—until that person appeared."
"Cang Yutian." Chen Ji blurted out that name. "The Ultimate Chess Player."

"Precisely." The Heavenly Dao's Eye emitted a low, mocking laugh. "He seized my divine position, occupied my body, and now continues his chess game in the depths of the universe. And I... was split in two, my fragmented body sealed here, my pages scattered across the mortal realm."

text.content: Chen Ji's mind raced rapidly. The Heavenly Dao's Eye—an ancient deity whose form was usurped by Cang Yutian; the Tianji Record—a part of the Heavenly Dao's Eye that was divided. If this information was true, then the origin of this treasure in his hands was completely clear.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's words were like heavy hammers, continuously striking Chen Ji's understanding. He needed to make a judgment: was this being before him friend or foe?

choices.description: Request the Heavenly Dao's Eye to prove its claims, asking for more details about the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming time, possibly missing the initiative
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Heavenly Dao's Eye, losing the opportunity for cooperation

text.content: "You say the Tianji Record is your fragmented body—" Chen Ji's voice was unhurried and calm. "Then can you tell me the content recorded on the fifth page? That is a part even I have never been able to interpret."

choices.description: Skip unnecessary testing, since the other party has demands, get straight to the point regarding the exchange of interests.
choices.visible_reward: Grasp the initiative in negotiation, displaying the temperament of a great schemer
choices.risk_hint: If the other party's demands exceed expectations, may fall into a passive position

text.content: "I can help you." Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, a slight curve at the corner of his lips. "But first I need to know—what can you give me? The complete Tianji Record, or... the power to oppose Cang Yutian?"

choices.description: Why would an ancient existence seek help from him? There must be something suspicious behind this.
choices.risk_hint: If what the other party says is true, may miss a great opportunity

text.content: "A堂堂 Heavenly Will, countless tribulations could not make it bow." Chen Ji's gaze turned sharp. "Why would it specifically seek out a mere Foundation Building waste disciple? Senior is too flattering to this junior."

dialogue.content: "Because you are like me." The Heavenly Eye's voice suddenly turned low. "Manipulated as chess pieces for thousands of years, yet never able to see the full picture of the chessboard. We are both... tools."

text.content: These words pierced the deepest chord in Chen Ji's heart. He recalled Mo Xiansheng's expression of wanting to speak yet holding back, the Heavenly Fate Value lost after each use of the Tianji Record, and those moments he thought he was controlling when he was actually being controlled.

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian scattered the Tianji Record throughout the world to find someone who could complete it." The Heavenly Eye continued. "He needs this item to complete a certain ritual—and you, are exactly the key he has chosen."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. A key? He was Cang Yutian's chosen key? This meant from the very beginning, obtaining the Tianji Record was not coincidence, but a meticulously arranged chess game.

dialogue.content: "But what you don't know is—" Cracks on the Heavenly Eye suddenly burst forth with dazzling light. "If you help him complete the ritual, you will die. Completely annihilated, without even a chance at reincarnation."

choice.prompt: The information about life and death struck like thunder. Chen Ji had to decide: in this destined dangerous game, which side would he stand on?

choices.description: The enemy of my enemy is my friend. Since we are all chess pieces, let's overturn the chessboard together.
choices.visible_cost: Binding with the ancient existence, sharing risks
choices.visible_reward: Obtain knowledge and power support from the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: May fall into an even deeper chess game

text.content: "Fine." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "I'll help you—but not as your chess piece, rather as a collaborator. I want half of the complete Tianji Record."

choices.text: Demand to see the complete version first
choices.description: Empty promises are not trustworthy. Must see the real leverage first.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Heavenly Eye's anger
choices.visible_reward: Mastering core resources means holding the initiative

text.content: "Words are worthless." Chen Ji extended his hand, palm facing upward. "Since we are to cooperate, give me the knowledge of the complete Tianji Record—even if just one page. Sincerity starts now."

choices.description: This could be another trap—he cannot easily trust anyone out of fear.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the chance to confront Cang Yutian
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independence and see more truths
choices.risk_hint: Relationship with Eye of Heavenly Way deteriorates

text.content: "What you say is quite brilliant, senior." Chen Ji stepped back, a playful smile on his face. "But why should I believe you're not sent by Cang Yutian to test me? After all—I'm just atrash disciple. Am I worth someone like you appearing in person?"

The moment Chen Ji's words fell, the entire Forbidden Grounds suddenly froze. The temperature plummeted, and a suffocating pressure seeped from the depths of the Void, as if an invisible eye was watching everything here.

dialogue.content: "...He's here." The Eye of Heavenly Way's voice suddenly carried a tremor. "Be careful—"

text.content: Chen Ji felt a vast, ocean-like power piercing through the Forbidden Grounds' barrier. A blurry figure took shape in the Void. It was a middle-aged man in plain white robes, his handsome face devoid of any expression, his eyes reflecting the birth and death of countless stars.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." The voice was ice-cold, completely devoid of emotional fluctuation. "You've done well. Now, hand over the Tianji Record to me—and then, quietly disappear."

text.content: Cang Yutian! The Ultimate Chess Player! Every nerve in Chen Ji's body tensed up. The Eye of Heavenly Way hadn't lied—this person truly existed, and he was demanding the Tianji Record from Chen Ji. The question was, how did Cang Yutian know he was here?

choice.prompt: The Ultimate Chess Player Cang Yutian reveals himself, and Chen Ji faces a life-or-death choice: submit to this irresistible force, or find a glimmer of hope in the desperate situation?

choices.description: Show weakness to the enemy, seek their flaws, secretly join forces with the Eye of Heavenly Way.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as genuine submission
choices.visible_reward: Buy time and watch for an opportunity to counterattack
choices.risk_hint: If seen through, may die on the spot

text.content: "The junior... is willing to hand over the Tianji Record." Chen Ji lowered his head, his voice carrying just the right amount of trembling, while secretly transmitting a divine message to the Eye of Heavenly Way: "Senior, are you ready?"

choices.description: Stall for time while gaining more information about the Ultimate Chess Player.
choices.risk_hint: May miss the chance to escape

text.content: "So you are the legendary Ultimate Chess Player?" Chen Ji stared directly into those eyes reflecting the stars. "May I ask, senior—from the moment the Tianji Record Fragment fell into my hands, everything I have done... has it all been within your calculations?"

choices.description: Since death is inevitable either way, I might as well fight with everything I have—perhaps I can carve out a path through the bloodshed.
choices.visible_cost: The disparity in strength is immense, and the odds of victory are extremely low.
choices.risk_hint: Extremely likely to result in death.

text.content: "Want the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji suddenly threw his head back in wild laughter, his voice tinged with madness. "Then come and take it! Let me see—just how formidable are the moves of the Ultimate Chessmaster!"
Chen Ji's questioning caused Cang Yutian to pause for a moment. A flicker of something unperceivable passed through those star-like eyes—was it mockery, or appreciation?

dialogue.content: "Scheming?" Cang Yutian spoke lightly. "Did you think you ever escaped my chessboard? From the moment you were born, you existed for this very moment—the Tianji Record needs you, and you need to become its nourishment."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. So that was it—he was no chosen one, but a sacrifice raised from the very beginning. The Tianji Record Fragment had selected him not because of his talent or effort, but simply because he happened to match the criteria for a certain sacrificial offering.

"However—" Cang Yutian's gaze shifted to that massive eye covered in cracks, his tone carrying more playfulness. "You've actually formed a connection with it? Interesting. It seems the Tianji Record is more restless than I imagined."

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian!" The Heavenly Celestial Eye erupted with furious light. "The debts of the Ten Thousand Calamities must be settled today!"

text.content: Caught between two terrifying forces, Chen Ji sensed the premonition of the Forbidden Grounds about to collapse. The confrontation between the Heavenly Celestial Eye and Cang Yutian was the peak battle Chen Ji had ever witnessed—and he was merely a Foundation Building ant.

"Chen Ji." Cang Yutian's voice suddenly became gentle, but this gentleness was more chilling than any threat. "Make your choice now. Help me complete the ritual, and I shall grant you eternity—OR,消散在虚无之中——与这个失败者一起，永远地消散。

Chen Ji closed his eyes slowly, feeling the warmth of the Tianji Record Fragment on the back of his hand. He contemplated: Eternal life? Becoming Cang Yutian's puppet, forever being moved around the chessboard? What use is such eternity!

"Senior." Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze firm as he looked at the Heavenly Celestial Eye. "I remember you saying that the complete Tianji Record is the key to breaking the shackles—does this still hold true?"

dialogue.content: "It holds true!" The Heavenly Celestial Eye erupted with unprecedented light. "As long as you stand on my side—I will tell you everything I know, including... how to reverse the Tianji Record's backlash!"

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made one of the most important decisions in his life. He turned to Cang Yutian, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth: "Senior Ultimate Chessmaster, my apologies—I detest being treated as a chess piece more than anything in this life."
